title: sql-query input
description: Input schema for the sql-query skill.

dsn.description: Data source name. Format: sqlite:///path/to/db.sqlite or postgres://user:pass@host:port/dbname. PostgreSQL uses TLS by default; add ?sslmode=disable only for trusted local development.

sql.description: Single SQL statement to execute (query operation only). Statements may read or modify data and schema.

params.description: Optional positional parameters for the SQL query.

table.description: Table name to describe (describe operation only).
